correctness.rationale: For independent bond events on a tree, the unique-path connection probability is exactly p^distance. Averaging the uniform nonvaccinated seed yields E_v=1+2F_v/(n-1). Every tree up to order seven appears in the exhaustive n^(n-2) Prüfer sequences: the package checker recomputes each candidate distance-count vector, verifies existence of a vertex with all prefix differences nonnegative and uses exact Abel summation for 0<=p<=1. The eight-vertex witness coefficient vectors are checked exactly; every noncandidate vertex is dominated by vertex 1 by the same prefix certificate, while F_2-F_1=p(p^2+p^3-1) changes sign once. Independent nonisomorphic-tree and explicit percolation-state checks support the finite computations; neither is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The independently checked exact smallest-order vaccination switch is not a direct implication of the accessed primary literature: Schneider et al. optimize immunization/fragmentation strategies, Altarelli et al. optimize via message-passing constraints, and Holme 2017 analyzes a continuous-time SIR model on graphs of at most seven vertices. Published-index semantic searches across bond percolation, random-seed vaccinees, tree susceptibility and crossover aliases found no exact covering statement. Nearby historical findings concern fixed infected roots or different vaccination designs. Bibliographic gaps remain a residual risk, not claimed exhaustive absence.

No independent external mathematical or bibliographic validation has been performed.

value.rationale: The single pre-exposure vaccine target is a natural control decision when an infection source is not known. The finding identifies the sharp minimal tree size at which that target must depend on homogeneous transmissibility and an exact algebraic crossover separating high-degree local protection from high-transmission fragmentation. A minimal classification with a global parameter comparison is a reusable small-network benchmark, not a renamed reliability polynomial or unmotivated parameter slice; biological extrapolation is explicitly excluded.
